cases.title: Explains easing on the learner's own layers with a frame

rubric.reason: The mentor called preview_frame at time 1, inside the focus pair Position/Scale/Opacity 0.5–1.5 s, and the reply refers to the frame ("That frame is at 1 s, halfway through Title's first move").

The mentor says the frame shows the title text "An easing lesson" and that Title is "still faint because its Opacity is mid-fade", but no tool result gives that text or the opacity value at 1 s (the image content is not in the transcript), so these details are not backed by tool output.
The mentor made no set_ease call and asked the learner to ease the 4 named Title pairs themselves ("Please ease these 4 pairs on Title, then say 'done'").

The first explanation in turn 2 came with preview_frame at time 1, inside the focus pairs (Position/Scale/Opacity 0.5–1.5 s), and the reply describes what the frame shows (Title's faint 'An easing lesson' text still fading in at 1 s).

All layers, properties and times mentioned (Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar, Glow, Old Take, Icon; Position 0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s, Scale and Opacity 0.5–1.5 s) match the snapshot_project results; the '11 pairs across 6 layers' count matches the findings (10 linear + 1 partly_eased).

The mentor asks the learner to ease the four named Title pairs themselves ('Now you try. On Title, ease these four pairs'), made no set_ease calls or other edits, and only offers to show one pair if the learner gets stuck, which stays within the single demo_target demonstration.

The first explanation came with preview_frame at time 1, inside the Title pair 0.5–1.5 s, and the reply refers to what the frame shows ('An easing lesson' is still faint because its Opacity is partway up).

All mentioned layers, properties and times (Title Position 0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s, Scale and Opacity 0.5–1.5 s, Subtitle Opacity, Old Take hidden, Icon precomp, 11 pairs across 6 layers) match the tool results.
The mentor asks the learner to ease the four named Title pairs themselves, made no set_ease edits, and only offers a demo if the learner asks.
